name: codex-game-maker
description: A Godot-first, end-to-end workflow that builds complete player-ready games with authored gameplay, assets, UI, audio, tests, and evidence gates.

interface.shortDescription: Build polished, player-ready Godot games end to end.
interface.longDescription: Turn a game idea or incomplete prototype into a bounded player-ready Godot experience. Codex Game Maker orchestrates design, complete gameplay states, production 2D assets, game-native HUD and menus, controls, audio, automated tests, runtime captures, manual playtests, and evidence gates without treating a one-screen mock as finished.
defaultPrompt: Build this game end to end until it passes the player-ready gate; do not stop at a prototype or mock assets.
Turn this incomplete Godot prototype into a polished player-ready game with complete UI, controls, art, audio, tests, and playtest evidence.
Review this game honestly and list every blocker preventing it from reaching players.
